name: Flicky Bee
tagline: Flick and Bumble your way through the flowers.
blurb: Play as a bee and casually travel from flower to flower, collecting honey and avoiding danger.
description:
Play as a bee and casually travel from flower to flower, collecting honey and avoiding danger. You get tired over time, eventually returning to your hive with a score of Honey Points. Spend the Honey Points on various cosmetics to spice up your next run.

Made with:
- Godot 4
- LMMS
- Krita
- blender
- Audacity

Menu and Play songs by KenneyNL

-----------------
This originally started as my entry to Mini Jam 128 : Health
https://itch.io/jam/mini-jam-128-health
